Before installing

Confirm your architecture, OS version and upstream requirements. Release filenames identify packages; they do not prove device compatibility. Your OS will ask for installation approval. These packages are published by the upstream maintainers and have not been rebuilt, executed or device-tested by ClawPort. Model weights, provider keys and services may need separate setup. Unverified means this catalog has not established availability, not that a project cannot support the platform.
